requirements.statement: A completed data-processing result targeting R0-R14 produces its register write, and an S-bit operation targeting R0-R14 produces the ALU NZCV write. Neither intent is emitted for R15.

A non-S ARM data-processing result targeting R15 produces an ARM-state PC write and pipeline-refill request. ARMv4/v5 require result bits[1:0] to be zero; another value is UNPREDICTABLE and produces no constrained PC-write intent.

source_refs.locator: §A2.4.3 Writing the program counter; §A3.3 Branch instructions
§8.7 Data operations, PC destination refill description

requirements.statement: An S-bit ARM data-processing result targeting R15 atomically branches and restores CPSR from the current-mode SPSR, deriving ARM/Thumb state and target alignment from restored SPSR.T. User or System mode has no SPSR, so this form is UNPREDICTABLE and emits no constrained PC or CPSR write.

source_refs.locator: §A2.6 Returning from an exception; §A4.1 data-processing S-bit operation
